authority: Project lead under existing autonomous CNY10000 research mandate; self-review, not independent approval
mechanism: Underlying money-market cash income held through a single fixed annual primary subscription/redemption episode; cash-management comparison, not a newly discovered timing alpha. Does not replace the original mandate.
exposure: Related historical/current performance snippets were incidentally exposed before this proposal. A2015Friday-to-Monday income response is retained opaque; only dates/field presence were inspected. No full-context blindness, freshOOS or historical-vintage claim. Local2026ETFholdout remains sealed.

fixed_execution.route: Cash subscription/redemption at contractual100CNYper share; whole shares, no secondary quote, spread or fabricated price slippage. Require each endpointPCF to agree with one159900cash component,100CNYreplacement and zero cash differences.
fixed_execution.fee_status: Unconfirmed all-in per-leg fee scenarios, not fund fees or verified broker tariffs; do not import the secondary-market5bps rate as a fact. Bank transfer and special redemption costs remain separate unresolved investor costs.
fixed_execution.quantity: Largest integer shares with100*shares+flat_entry_fee<=1000. Same fixed shares through exit.
fixed_execution.eligibility: Require primary flags, active cap fields and sufficient disclosed caps for quantity. Positive fund caps must accommodate at most1percent participation. Missing active fields fail source admission; inactive legacy fields remain explicitly missing, not filled with zero. Zero caps use reviewed official meaning no limit. Unknown intraday remaining capacity stays a condition, never a guaranteed fill.
fixed_execution.failed_eligibility: Retain zero filled shares and zeroPnL for that fixed opportunity; do not replace its date or exclude it from statistics. Source invalidity stops the diagnostic before income value inspection.

income.basis: Official Aclass incomeUnit is daily or explicitly aggregated closed-calendar-run income per100physical shares. Shares are100CNYeach. Do not use incomeRatio or prices.
income.entitlement: From next open session after entry through exit date inclusive. These boundaries cannot split a closed-calendar-run aggregate.
income.allowed_date_shapes: Every open session has one row. Each closed run has either all daily rows, one final-day aggregate, or partitions ending at December31and the run final day. Any other partial shape fails source admission. Year-end partition semantics are an inference from dates, conditional on the separately fixed seven-day identity checks; do not assume disjoint sums from dates alone.
income.decimal: Parse signed finite four-decimal income values only inside the later registered one-use execution. Preserve negative amounts. No annual fund-operation fee subtraction because disclosed income is already fund net realized income.
income.rounding_status: Pro-rata cash less the stated per-calendar-day allowance is a declared stress model, not a certified lower bound on individual clearing allocation. Do not label it actual account cash.
income.payment_timing: 2015monthly and2023-06-05daily payment rules retained. This first diagnostic sums earned income without reinvestment and does not claim exact cash availability or payment-transfer charges.

seven_day_consistency.formula: For Aclass, seven-day income per100shares = incomeRatio_in_percentage_points *700/365. Compare with sum of report-period incomeUnit values covering the same7calendar days, with no partial period allowed.
seven_day_consistency.basis: First ordinary Friday-to-Monday probe and the first open day after each of the five irregular cross-year closures identified by date-only metadata. No endpoint chosen by income values.
seven_day_consistency.tolerance_basis: Official four-decimal income and three-decimal percentage annualized-yield rounding; arithmetic error propagation, not empirical fitting.
seven_day_consistency.failure: Stop with source inconsistency; compute no annual strategyPnL and do not try alternate scaling, holiday overlap or dates to rescue the candidate.
seven_day_consistency.access: Only inside the later claimed, fingerprinted one-use execution. No income values inspected while amending this source shape.

criteria.meaning: Conditional cash-feasibility screen only. Nine predeclared annual observations cannot independently certify profitability, unusual tail risk, daily risk or paper promotion. No threshold changes after data access.

uncertainty.method: Circular blocks of2consecutive annual opportunities; draw5starts from0..8withreplacement, concatenate and takefirst9observations, averagePnL; NumPylinear2.5/97.5quantiles. Conditional dependent-sample diagnostic, not freshOOS or multiple-testing correction.

reporting: Every fixed interval and all six fee/rounding scenarios
Full/later mean, total, positive frequency, worst opportunity and primary block interval
Additional unmodeled investor-fee headroom per opportunity

source_scope.income_before_registration: Retain original opaque; extract response count, schema keys, dates, income-field presence/nullness only. No income values, annualized yields, performance or sign aggregates. Stop for source review if truncated or dates incomplete; no extra pages or dates.
